response.justification: Despite extensive full-stack and open-source experience, the candidate lacks demonstrable C++ production experience beyond a brief role at National Instruments, with no evidence of modern C++/STL, multi-threading, message brokers, IEC 62443, or industrial automation systems — all core requirements for this role.
strengths: Strong full-stack and open-source contributions with diverse tech exposure
Proven experience in distributed systems, event-driven architectures, and DevOps tooling
Excellent communication and mentoring background through workshops and talks
concerns: Minimal recent or relevant C++ experience; primary stack is JavaScript/TypeScript/DLang
No evidence of industrial cybersecurity standards (IEC 62443), MQTT, or industrial protocols
Lacks documented experience in high-performance C++ networking, concurrency, or on-prem cloud hybrid systems
